items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I was out on the West Coast with Eddie Heywood. I played with Frankie before then with Eddie Heywood.

ctx.x: When we were sort of talking about your associations before, your career, we got to Basie and then back to Benny Carter. And I guess that was about the end of your big band days.

Well, yes. Yes, it was, because then I started getting with the smaller groups, like Frankie Newton, and Sidney Bechet, Eddie Heywood, and Jimmy McPartland...and Bobby Hackett... I did some things with Max
